overviewHtml:
Teams that want to separate log data in Grail, for example for retention or access, need a working bucket and routing rule to start from.

What you get

  • Monaco project that creates a custom Grail bucket
  • A rule that routes specific logs to the new bucket
  • Manifest and config files ready to adapt
  • A simple pattern for managing buckets as code
prereqsHtml:
• Monaco >=v2.9.0
  • Dynatrace Platform environment
  • OAuth client as described here.
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco, a Dynatrace Platform environment and an OAuth client.

  1. Point the Monaco manifest at your environment
  2. Adjust the bucket definition and log routing rule
  3. Deploy the project with Monaco
